events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported that eight ride-hailing (ojol) services have stopped operating in Indonesia, some after going bankrupt, and published a list.
events.why_it_matters: Shows how brutal the ojol market is just as Green SM Bike enters and users/drivers may lose services.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported that US President Trump abruptly banned the construction of data centres outside the US (headline only; article not opened).
events.why_it_matters: Could hit Indonesia's data-centre and AI investment plans; needs confirmation of scope.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported GTA VI earned a record Rp69 trillion on its launch day (headline only; article not opened).
events.why_it_matters: A single number that makes the scale of gaming vs. film and the Rp1.3 million price tangible.

events.event: detikInet reported Q3 2026 subscriber numbers fell year-on-year at Telkomsel, XLSmart and Indosat while ARPU rose, as operators chase revenue over subscribers.
events.key_numbers: Telkomsel 151.1 juta, -4.1% · XLSmart 69.5 juta, -12.1% · Indosat 91.5 juta, -3.3% · ARPU XLSmart Rp47.500 (+22.1%), Indosat Rp46.000 (+15%), Telkomsel Rp44.900 (+3.5%)
events.why_it_matters: Fewer SIMs but higher revenue per user hints that ordinary users pay more per month.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported that two apps favoured by scammers in Indonesia are used by almost everyone (headline only).
events.why_it_matters: Tells ordinary users which apps to be careful on; apps need identifying.

events.event: detikInet reported malware attacks targeting PC gamers are rising alongside GTA VI hype, and that watching on IndoXXI/LK21 can drain bank accounts.
events.why_it_matters: Gamers and illegal-streaming viewers risk losing money.

events.event: detikInet reported on the Google-Komdigi meeting and the sovereignty debate over the closure of about 19,000 pro-government YouTube channels.
events.why_it_matters: Who decides what stays online in Indonesia: Google or the government.

events.event: BNI begins closing BNI Mobile Banking in stages from 30 November (already known; falls just after the coming week).
